We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

_Do you want to lead complex development projects and bring people together to turn ambitious ideas into tangible results? Are you motivated by creating direction, driving progress, and making a visible impact across an international organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing complex development projects across functions and stakeholders through all project phases. The development projects can be electronic hardware, software, and/or services. By creating the right conditions and removing obstacles, you will enable project teams to succeed, while fostering collaboration, engagement, and ownership across the organization.

More specifically, you will be:

• Driving end-to-end project execution, including planning, governance, and follow-up

• Facilitating alignment between commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders

• Creating transparency on project progress, dependencies, and key decisions

• Ensuring the right balance between scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while managing risks and ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Challenging assumptions, priorities, and scope as well as facilitating difficult discussions and driving decision

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology products in a highly collaborative and innovative environment. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across the business and have a significant impact on both individual projects and the way we collaborate across functions.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting directly to our Director of Project Execution, you will join the Project Execution department in Heat/Cooling. The team consists of 4 dedicated and experienced project managers with deep knowledge of both our business and organization. We bring experienced project leadership, structure, and transparency to complex development projects, helping turn ambition into successful execution. We foster a collaborative and open atmosphere, as we believe successful projects are built through collaboration, trust, accountability, and the courage to challenge existing ideas.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an experienced Project Manager with a proven track record of leading complex projects. You enjoy working with people from different professional backgrounds, while collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Have proven project management experience as well as an ability to deliver complex projects in a large organization

• Can establish trust, create alignment, and maintain momentum in projects that involve multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Bring a constructive mindset and the ability to challenge existing ways of working

• Have a structured approach to work, allowing you to turn complexity into clarity

• Ideally have experience from product development, engineering, or other development environments

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

Landfolk is looking for a Digital Product Designer to bring our marketplace, host products and internal tools to life through delightful UX and beautifully crafted UI. You’ll help shape and improve our product, making exceptional stays effortless to discover, host and experience.

What Excites Us About This Role

We’re looking for a designer, not an artist. A product builder, not a picture maker – someone who cares how things work as much as how they look, for both our users and our internal teams.

You’ll work across the live product and new opportunities. You’ll find friction, frame problems, explore solutions, follow your work through to implementation and iterate based on data/user feedback. Sometimes that means simplifying a booking flow. Sometimes it means improving host onboarding, making an internal workflow easier to manage or making something new completely from scratch.

The way product teams work is changing quickly, as AI tools and vibe coding can shorten the path from an idea to something people can try. We are looking for a designer who uses these tools to explore, build, release experiments and learn quickly. Someone who brings the judgment to know what is useful, what needs testing and what is ready to ship.

What You’ll Actually Do

This isn't a big company product role where you'll spend months discussing and debating different paths forward. You'll have real influence on what we build and how we build it. Your decisions will ship to production, not disappear into committees.

You'll work on a product that matters to real people. Hosts who depend on us for income, and guests creating memories with family and friends. When you make the product better, you'll see it in their messages and reviews.

We work in focused cycles that give teams clear ownership and time to do meaningful work. The environment is low-distraction, collaborative and informal, with a mix of specialists who care about making the product better.

Your key responsibilities:

• Design and improve product experiences across web & app, from idea to implementation

• Create playful interactions and micro-moments that bring warmth and personality into the product, delighting users in small ways, not just solving problems

• Work across the full Landfolk ecosystem for guests, hosts, partners, and internal tools

• Move from problem framing and user flows to detailed UI and implementation

• Work closely with the other product designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, and business units to understand real needs and ship useful improvements

• Use and evolve Landfolk’s design language system

• Use AI to work smarter through our agent Pax in Figma, vibe coding prototypes and other tools

• Learn from feedback, product data and real usage, then refine what you’ve shipped

About You

• You have designed and shipped digital products, and can show how your work improved an experience or solved a real problem

• You can work across the full design process, from understanding a problem and shaping the experience to producing polished UI

• You have a strong visual eye and care about craft, clarity and consistency

• You have hands-on experience with vibe coding or AI-assisted product development, and can show how it helped you explore, test and execute an idea

• You’re comfortable working with ambiguity, making trade-offs and moving from an early idea to a practical solution

• You use feedback well and can explain the thinking behind your design decisions

• Figma will be part of your daily work, and you’re more interested in design than coding

• You collaborate closely with engineers and understand how design choices translate into a working product, and you should be comfortable working with code and exploring AI tools

• You have experience designing and shipping apps.

• Experience with marketplaces, e-commerce or products with multiple user groups is a plus

Curious about Landfolk?

At Landfolk, we believe the most memorable holidays happen in homes that are loved and lived in. We’re united by curiosity and driven by a shared purpose of helping people reconnect with nature, culture and the people they love.

You’ll be part of a fast-growing and purpose-driven company with more than 9000 handpicked holiday homes in Norway, Sweden, Germany, Italy, France, Spain and Denmark.

With us, you’ll:

• Learn and grow with more than 100 talented colleagues across tech, commercial, customer care, and creative teams

• Be trusted, take ownership and let curiosity guide your work and development

• Work in a welcoming, open-minded atmosphere where teamwork comes naturally

• Explore how AI can support your work, experiment with your team, and share what you learn

• Enjoy flexible working hours, a beautiful office in Aarhus and plenty of moments to come together

• Join trips to beautiful holiday homes

Read more about us here

Ready to join us?

This is a full-time hybrid position based in Aarhus. You’ll work from our office several days a week, with flexibility on others. We’re looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

Don’t send us a generic CV. Show us that you understand Landfolk, both who we are and the identity we’ve built. Show us how you think, the product experiences and final designs you’ve created, and the reasoning behind your decisions.

This is a creative role, so feel free to show that in how you apply. The format is up to you. What matters most is how you tell your story.

When you apply, include:

• Links or visuals of products and apps you’ve designed

• Figma files or explorations that show how you approach interface design

• Your thoughts on what makes a great vacation rental experience — and how thoughtful design can shape it.

• A few paragraphs on why you want to design user experiences at Landfolk. We’re interested in how you think and what you’ve learned, as well as the finished work.

We review applications and interview candidates on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as you’re ready, and no later than 15 November 2026.

Relocation and visa assistance is not offered for this position.

Are you ready to spark transformation and make an impact at a leading global brand? Look no further!

As part of our Digital and Technology organisation, we are looking for a Programme Manager to lead the rollout projects of our SAP S/4HANA solution across our core value chain. You will join our Delivery Excellence department, working closely with Delivery Leads, Project Managers, Programme Managers, and other delivery roles.

Our global SAP S/4HANA business transformation programme has established the foundation, template and delivery experience required to transform and standardize core business processes across Pandora. Having successfully progressed through the initial rollout waves, we are now entering the next phase: scaling deployment across markets and business units globally. Our ambition is to make each subsequent rollout faster, more efficient and increasingly repeatable, leveraging a mature global template, standardized delivery approach and lessons learned from previous deployments. This position will be instrumental in driving this evolution, taking ownership of end-to-end rollout delivery while helping build a scalable, high-performing rollout capability that combines speed and efficiency with strong business outcomes, adoption and delivery quality.

We would like to hear from you if you are passionate about orchestrating complex deliveries, a strong delivery leader who can guide and influence teams, and an enabler who fosters alignment and collaboration. You bring a structured yet empowering approach, grounded in a servant-leadership mindset. You have solid experience in programme management and have previously worked in roles such as Programme Manager, Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar, ideally within an SAP ECC or S/4HANA transformation. You do not need to be the SAP solution expert, but you understand what it takes to lead one, and you know the right questions to ask and when to challenge. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with diverse stakeholders, where your communication, coordination, and relationship-building skills are essential to driving successful outcomes.

In your role as Programme Manager you will:

• 
Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP S/4HANA rollouts, from mobilization and design through build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality while protecting business continuity.

• 
Drive rollout scale, speed and efficiency, applying standardized ways of working, lessons learned and continuous improvement to make successive deployments increasingly predictable, repeatable and efficient.

• 
Mobilize and lead cross-functional rollout teams, securing the right business and technology resources, establishing clear accountabilities, governance and ways of working, and creating strong collaboration across global and local teams.

• 
Own the integrated rollout plan and critical path, actively managing dependencies, resource constraints, risks, issues and competing initiatives, identifying potential bottlenecks early and driving timely resolution.

• 
Partner closely with business leaders and functional teams to ensure business requirements are understood, the global template is adopted effectively, and the organization is ready for the change.

• 
Provide strong delivery governance and executive transparency, establishing relevant performance metrics, facilitating Steering Committees, enabling timely decision-making and escalating material risks or issues when required.

• 
Orchestrate execution across design, build and testing, ensuring scope and design decisions are aligned with template standards, build activities progress to plan, and integration and user acceptance testing provide confidence in business and solution readiness.

• 
Lead cutover and go-live readiness, coordinating business cutover, data migration, dress rehearsals, readiness assessments, contingency planning and go/no-go decision-making to enable a controlled and successful launch.

• 
Lead the transition into hypercare and steady-state operations, ensuring system stability, rapid resolution of critical issues, effective knowledge transfer and clear criteria for hypercare exit.

• 
Manage the performance of system integration and delivery partners, setting clear expectations, monitoring delivery against commitments and proactively addressing or escalating performance challenges.

• 
Champion continuous improvement across the rollout portfolio, translating experience and lessons learned into simpler processes, stronger delivery practices and opportunities to accelerate future rollouts.

What is needed to succeed:

• 
Demonstrated experience leading complex programmes or large-scale transformations in a global organisation.

• 
Practical SAP S/4HANA programme experience, in a leadership role, covering stages from design and build through testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare

• 
Experience working with vendor-led delivery and SAP implementation partners.

• 
Strong coordination, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to turn complexity into concise, actionable messages.

• 
Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and driving challenging discussions and decisions.

• 
Comfortable working in matrixed, multi-team and international environments.

• 
A delivery mindset, taking ownership for outcomes and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Do you enjoy turning data into insights and forecasts that help a global business make better decisions? Are you motivated by working across markets and functions, balancing availability, inventory and commercial priorities?

We are looking for a Specialist, POSM Demand Planning to join our Global Merchandising & Supply Chain organisation in Copenhagen. In this role, you will support our global demand planning for Point of Sale Materials (POSM), covering areas such as packaging, accessories, displays, sellable items and services.

Your role

As our Demand Planning Specialist, you will help develop accurate, reliable and insight-driven item-level forecasts aligned with our commercial, marketing and inventory objectives.

You will work closely with clusters and global teams, with particular focus on new launches and item transitions. Through strong analysis and collaboration, you will help us improve availability while managing inventory and reducing the risk of obsolescence.

Your key responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• 
Support and execute the global POSM demand planning process, ensuring forecasts are delivered according to agreed timelines and standards.

• 
Consolidate and validate forecasts across clusters, ensuring strong data quality and timely cross-functional input.

• 
Develop item-level forecasts across packaging, accessories, displays and sellable POSM.

• 
Maintain statistical baseline forecasts using demand history, market intelligence, marketing plans, sell-in signals and lifecycle changes.

• 
Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, identify key demand drivers and conduct root-cause analyses to recommend corrective actions.

• 
Translate planning and performance data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.

• 
Partner with Marketing, Clusters, Supply Planning and Procurement to build reliable forecasts for new launches and SKU transitions.

• 
Support phase-in and phase-out planning and proactively identify potential excess inventory, shortages and obsolescence risks.

• 
Work closely with clusters and global functions to align demand plans with commercial calendars, marketing campaigns, inventory targets and supply constraints.

• 
Contribute to improvements in planning processes, data and systems, helping strengthen planning quality, efficiency and inventory outcomes.

What we’re looking for

You are analytical and comfortable working with data, but equally confident turning numbers into a clear story for stakeholders. You enjoy collaborating across functions and markets, challenging assumptions constructively and taking ownership when something needs to move forward.

We imagine that you bring:

• 
1–3 years of relevant experience within Demand Planning, Supply Planning and/or Merchandise Planning.

• 
A relevant educational background in areas such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Finance & Economics or International Business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• 
Practical experience with forecasting, statistical modelling and root-cause analysis.

• 
An understanding of end-to-end supply chain and inventory trade-offs.

• 
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• 
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across functions.

• 
A curious, proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint.

• 
Experience with Logility or a similar demand planning system, and/or Aptos or another allocation system.

• 
Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query or QlikView is considered an advantage.

• 
Fluency in English.

Experience from retail, fashion or FMCG, as well as working in a global organisation across multiple markets or clusters, would be an advantage

Step into a unique opportunity to build and lead the Legal function of one of the Nordics' fastest-growing digital infrastructure companies.

**Build the Legal Function During an Important Phase of Growth

**Are you a commercially minded legal executive who thrives at the intersection of business, strategy, and law?

Backed by leading international investors and operating across the Nordics, the company is entering an exciting new phase of growth and expansion.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will become a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the Board, and investors, while playing a key role in some of the company's most important strategic and commercial decisions. To succeed, you must be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a complex, fast-moving environment. You combine strong legal expertise with commercial judgement and a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, and you have the ability to build legal capabilities, frameworks, and teams that support growth and long-term value creation.

Do you love turning data into insights that drive better commercial decisions? Are you motivated by working at the intersection of merchandising, inventory and performance?

We are looking for a Specialist, Merchandise Controlling & OTB - Interim to join our Global Merchandise Controlling & OTB team.

In this role, you will be at the heart of Pandora’s merchandise planning process. You will support global planning and reporting, analyse performance and inventory, and help turn complex data into clear insights that support commercial decisions and future buys.

Working across clusters and global teams, you will play an important role in connecting sell-out, sell-in and inventory planning while identifying risks and opportunities along the way.

Your key responsibilities

Merchandise Controlling & Reporting

• 
Support the consolidation of top-down merchandise financial plans across assigned clusters.

• 
Analyse cluster assumptions and identify potential risks, gaps and opportunities.

• 
Support reporting across key commercial metrics including sell-out, revenue, units, ASP and sell-in.

• 
Conduct performance and variance analysis against budget, forecast and last year.

• 
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that enable better decision-making.

• 
Use AI-enabled tools to strengthen analysis, spot trends and generate actionable insights.

Inventory & Sell-In Planning

• 
Develop and maintain sell-in plans aligned with inventory guidelines, stock coverage targets and commercial priorities.

• 
Adjust plans based on the latest sell-out expectations, inventory positions, product flows and commercial developments.

• 
Monitor inventory health and identify areas requiring action.

• 
Partner with cluster and global merchandising teams to challenge assumptions and ensure alignment between sell-out, sell-in and inventory plans.

Business Partnering & Continuous Improvement

• 
Collaborate closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Inventory Strategy, Merchandise Planning, Demand Planning and Allocation.

• 
Help maintain consistent and accurate planning assumptions across commercial and operational teams.

• 
Contribute to improving planning, reporting and analytical processes.

• 
Explore new tools, methodologies and AI-enabled solutions that can make business steering more efficient and insightful.

What we’re looking for

You are naturally analytical and enjoy getting into the detail, but you can also step back and understand the bigger commercial picture. You are structured, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

Just as importantly, you enjoy collaborating with others and building strong relationships across teams and markets.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Economics, International Business or a related field.

• 
2+ years of experience within Merchandising, Supply Chain or Controlling.

• 
Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, with advanced Excel skills.

• 
Experience working with and interpreting large datasets.

• 
A solid understanding of inventory and planning principles, including stock coverage, replenishment and inventory health.

• 
Strong communication and presentation skills.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across functions.

• 
Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis and efficiency.

• 
Experience from retail, fashion or FMCG is a strong advantage, while exposure to a global organisation is also beneficial.

Your new team

You will join the Global Merchandise Controlling & OTB team, currently consisting of three managers and four specialists. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment with plenty of opportunities to collaborate across the organisation, develop your commercial understanding and make an impact on how we plan and manage our global merchandise business.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. **About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.
